region_1785944283705_ouz5515s.name: General Store Interior
region_1785944283705_ouz5515s.description: A well-organized store with aisles of food, tools, fabrics, and household items. A counter near the front holds a ledger, a scale, and a small cash box. Storage shelves along the back wall hold bulk goods and seasonal stock.

region_1785944283705_x2xnnyjk.name: Willowmere
region_1785944283705_x2xnnyjk.description: A lush valley of glowing willow trees and quiet meadows where herbal healers and farmers live in harmony with the land. Small cottages dot the landscape, and the air hums with gentle protective magic.

region_1785944283706_h8h242oz.name: Thornbriar Crossings
region_1785944283706_h8h242oz.description: A busy trade hub where merchant caravans, workshops, and market stalls connect rural settlements to larger cities. The air smells of spices, oil, and freshly printed broadsheets.

region_1785944283706_hrpqdbrn.name: Scarlet Ridge Highlands
region_1785944283706_hrpqdbrn.description: A rugged mountain region of stone paths, training grounds, and fortified homesteads where warrior clans patrol and teach combat skills. Cold winds sweep through the ridges, and the ground is marked with old battle scars.

region_1785944283707_phm4xe1t.name: Craft Workshop Interior
region_1785944283707_phm4xe1t.description: A tidy workshop with workbenches, hanging tools, and stacks of wood and fabric scraps. A small stove keeps the space warm, and shelves hold half-finished projects and reference sketches. The floor is worn smooth from years of use.

region_1785944283707_nk5e6vu5.name: Ember Hollow Rest House Interior
region_1785944283707_nk5e6vu5.description: A warm common room with a fireplace, wooden tables, and comfortable chairs. A small dining area connects to the kitchen, and a hallway leads to several guest rooms. The walls are decorated with local artwork and travel maps.

region_1785944283707_hu3zf4lt.name: Willowmere Forest Grove
region_1785944283707_hu3zf4lt.description: A dense but gentle forest of old willow and oak trees where foragers, herbalists, and quiet travelers find shelter and rare plants. Sunlight filters through the canopy in soft patches, and the ground is soft with moss and fallen leaves.

region_1786438821952_m5baxvz2.name: QA Frost March
region_1786438821952_m5baxvz2.description: A deterministic frozen frontier used only for cross-region movement and hydration tests.
